name: neobank_user_contribution_payback
question_template: A fictional neobank models one user. An acquisition cost of {CAC} USD is paid once, at month 0, before month 1 begins; it is not part of any monthly contribution but is included in cumulative contribution from month 0 onward. In every month the user spends {SPEND} USD on the card and the bank earns interchange equal to {IC_RATE} percent of that spend. The user's deposit balance is {D0} USD at the beginning of month 1. Net interest income for a month accrues on the balance at the beginning of that month at an annual net interest margin of {NIM} percent divided by 12. At the end of every month the balance changes by a net deposit inflow of {G} USD (negative means outflow); the change is persistent, carrying into all later months, and the balance is floored at zero. Monthly servicing cost is {S} USD. Monthly contribution for a month equals interchange plus net interest income minus servicing cost for that month. Cumulative contribution after month t equals minus the acquisition cost plus the sum of monthly contributions for months 1 through t. The payback month is the first month t in 1 through {N} whose cumulative contribution is at least zero; it is 0 if no such month exists. What is the cumulative contribution after month {N} in USD?

slots.description: Deposit balance at the beginning of the final month N, after floor
Monthly contribution flow for month N alone, excluding acquisition cost
First month with cumulative contribution at least zero, or 0 if none

program:
def solve():
    cac = P["CAC"]
    spend = P["SPEND"]
    ic = P["IC_RATE"]
    d0 = P["D0"]
    nim = P["NIM"]
    g = P["G"]
    s = P["S"]
    n = P["N"]
    if n < 1:
        raise ValueError("horizon must be at least one month")
    bal = d0
    cum = -cac
    payback = 0
    contrib_n = 0
    bal_n = 0
    for t in range(1, n + 1):
        if t == n:
            bal_n = bal
        interchange = spend * ic / 100
        nii = bal * nim / 100 / 12
        c = interchange + nii - s
        cum = cum + c
        if payback == 0 and cum >= 0:
            payback = t
        if t == n:
            contrib_n = c
        bal = bal + g
        if bal < 0:
            bal = 0
    return {
        "final": cum,
        "balance_begin_month_n": bal_n,
        "contribution_month_n": contrib_n,
        "payback_month": payback,
    }
